# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.1 Stage 2 Package 3, Second Rome vs Third Rome (oe_rom3_, slot 48). Generated by gen_third_rome.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Ultra-lightweight fallback monthly pulse for Second & Third Rome (post-1470).
# When scheduler slot 48 has already ticked this month, oe_rom3_ran_m matches oe_rom3_m_now and this trigger is false.
# Rebel-guarded per fx17_rebel_guard.py; ensures Rus' still runs Translatio Imperii if BYZ has fallen.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_rom3_fallback_pulse } }

oe_rom3_fallback_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        is_ai = no
        is_rebel_country = no
        current_year >= 1470
        NOT = { global_var:oe_rom3_ran_m ?= oe_rom3_m_now }
        OR = {
            AND = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
            tag = ROM
            oe_rus_country = yes
        }
    }
    effect = {
        oe_ml_mark_start = yes
        if = { limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes } oe_rom3_monthly = yes }
    }
}
